meta.title: 6 habits that are secretly killing your confidence

beats.text: Six everyday habits that are quietly killing your confidence.
One. Talking to yourself in a way you'd never dare talk to a friend.
Two. Breaking small promises to yourself. Each broken one chips away at your self-trust.
Three. Measuring your real life against everyone's highlight reel online.
Four. Avoiding hard things. Confidence is built from evidence — and avoidance gives you none.
Five. Needing constant reassurance. Outsourcing your worth keeps it forever out of your hands.
Six. Perfectionism — so afraid of visible effort and failure that you never fully try.
Confidence isn't a feeling you're waiting on. It's the quiet trust you earn by keeping your own word.
